initiative: Qualify a second supplier for the hydraulic valve assembly line

work_packages.title: Supplier capability assessment
work_packages.deliverable: Capability assessment report with all audit findings closed

work_packages.title: First article inspection and process validation
work_packages.deliverable: First article inspection record and a validated process control plan

work_packages.title: Dual-source production ramp
work_packages.deliverable: Second source released to full production volume

approval_chain.name: Supplier qualification gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Audit findings closed and no open deviations against the assessment checklist

approval_chain.name: Production release gate review
approval_chain.criteria: First article inspection accepted and process controls demonstrated capable

compliance_notes: Second source qualification follows the ISO 9001 change control procedure; the change record requires sign-off before release.
Any non-conformance found during first article inspection is dispositioned and closed before the production release gate review.

risks.risk: Second source tooling lead time extends past the qualification window
risks.mitigation: Place the tooling order at the qualification gate review instead of after production release

risks.risk: Process capability at the second source falls short of the specified control limits
risks.mitigation: Run an extended capability study and hold the ramp deliverable until controls are demonstrated
